_comment: R39 block-2 spell descriptions (g# = 1-based FFFF-record index in block2, off 3648). Spells = g3..g58. Encoded into the shared spell-font atlas (== data/english_glyph_table.json, GS TBP 0x3000) which carries the FULL char-32 set: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, space, and punctuation ('.'=14, ','=12, "'"=7, '-'=13, '/'=15, etc.). Text is PROPER CASE with real punctuation; the patcher encodes verbatim via english_glyph_table.json (USE_ENGLISH_ATLAS=True) with NO lowercasing/no drop. ' / ' = a 0xFFFE line break. Re-wrapped so every line <= 26 cells and <= 2 lines. g55/56/57 lack real source text and SHIP PRISTINE JAPANESE.
